proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: The boards of trustees of the New York City Employees' Retirement System, the New York City Teachers' Retirement System, the New York City Police Pension Fund and the New York City Fire Pension Fund (the Systems), acting through the Comptroller of the City of New York
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring initial candidate lists for new director nominees and outside-hired CEOs to include qualified female and racially/ethnically diverse candidates, including from third-party consultants.
